# GitHub Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and `data/AGENTS.md` before changing this tool or generating data.
Populate `data/tree-data.json` from the user's source material, then run
`node scripts/sync-data.cjs` to validate and regenerate the browser data adapter.
Do not edit `data/tree-data.js` directly. Preserve the application's existing features.
